notes: Four development cases on the frozen real Kroger catalog. Not held-out or a replacement for the frozen 20-task benchmark. Variants deliberately share wording; run high only. Hidden goals and private shopper profiles are not passed to the agent. Feedback changes a soft preference, not a hard constraint or the scored goal.
